question: What claim is made about the speaker's present desire with respect to the worship of the siddhas?
premises: The worship of the siddhas is the object in view.
The speaker wishes to hear about it now.
The desired source of hearing is the gurus.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear about the worship of the siddhas from the gurus.
uncertainties: No details of that worship are given in this verse.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear about the worship of the siddhas from the gurus.
